subject: Hosted API eval — quickstart & rate limits
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@finly.com>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@finly.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API eval — quickstart & rate limits

Thanks again for your time this morning, Samantha — great to meet you and Mike. Quick recap and next steps from our demo:

- What we covered: Hosted API quickstart, sample integration for your ingestion pipeline, and basic cost/latency expectations on our curation model.
- Your priority: fast time-to-prod for the summarization pilot (low infra overhead) and clear SLA/limits so your engineers can estimate cost.
- Key constraint you mentioned: data residency/regulatory checks for audit logs (we discussed having logs retained in us-west region).

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share a simple quickstart guide and a suggested Postman collection so your engineers can spin up a test endpoint within an hour.
2) Marissa from our SE team will follow up with recommended endpoint configs and expected rate limits for the traffic profile you sketched (50 concurrent users, ~2 requests/sec/user, avg 350 tokens/response).
3) If things look good we can spin up a 2-week hosted eval with isolated API keys and dedicated project billing so you can validate latency and cost before discussing Dedicated capacity.

Attachments: I’m including the quickstart doc and a short rate-limit cheat sheet in my next email (PDF + md).

Ask: Can you confirm the engineer who’ll run the integration (name + email) and whether the audit-log retention window needs to be >90 days?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up if you want to walk through the quickstart live.
—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@finly.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@finly.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval — quickstart & rate limits

Thanks Aditya — good recap. Quick answers:

- Engineer: Jenna Park (jenna.park@finly.com) will own the test integration.
- Audit logs: we need 180-day retention for the initial pilot due to compliance with our internal audit team. If that’s a hard blocker we may need to discuss private options, but for the hosted eval we can start with 180 days if configurable.
- Traffic: the numbers I gave earlier were conservative — realistic load for week 1 is closer to 20 concurrent users, 1 req/sec/user, but can spike. We mostly need predictable rate limits and a plan for graceful throttling.

Can you also confirm: do you support VPC egress IP allowlisting from the hosted environment (we’ll need to whitelist outgoing callbacks to our internal webhooks)?

Thanks — Samantha
VP Product, Finly

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@finly.com>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@finly.com>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@finly.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval — quickstart & rate limits

Perfect — thanks for the details, Samantha. Short answers inline:

- 180-day retention: We can support configurable audit-log retention up to 365 days on Hosted for enterprise customers. For the eval we can enable a 180-day retention window for your project. I’ll note it as a requirement on the eval.
- VPC egress allowlisting: For hosted we offer static egress IP ranges per-region that you can whitelist for outbound callbacks; for tighter networking we can also discuss a private deployment or VPC peering.

I’ve looped in Jenna on this thread. Jenna — I’ll send the quickstart + Postman collection and an API-key provisioning flow. Marissa will follow up with specific endpoint configs and rate-limit guidance (see her note below).

Attached: redwood-hosted-quickstart.md (installation + sample curl/Postman), rate-limit-sheet.pdf (recommended throughput tiers).

Next: I’ll provision an eval project and share isolated keys by EOD Monday. If you want the live walk-through earlier, we can schedule 30 minutes next week.
—
Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@finly.com>, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@finly.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@finly.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval — quickstart & rate limits

Hi Jenna/Samantha — jumping in with the technical details we discussed:

Recommended Hosted endpoint config for your pilot:
- Model: redwood-curie-2027 (balanced latency/cost for summarization)
- Endpoint: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (we’ll create a project-scoped endpoint for the eval)
- Auth: Bearer API key (proj_ prefixed)
- Typical response size: ~350 tokens (avg)

Rate limits / throughput guidance (Hosted):
- Default shared limit: 60 req/minute per API key (burst to 120) — not sufficient for your pilot spikes.
- Suggested eval tier (isolated project): 150 req/minute per key, with concurrency up to 100 rps across the project.
- Graceful throttling: we return HTTP 429 with Retry-After header; recommend exponential backoff with jitter.

Observability / logs:
- Audit logs: accessible in Console (exportable) and retained for 180 days for the eval project as requested.
- Metrics: per-route latency percentiles, token consumption, and trace IDs for debugging.

If you expect sustained >150 req/minute we recommend a short Dedicated commit (1-3 month) or temporary burst capacity. For the eval we can provision the suggested tier and monitor — we can raise limits if needed.

I’ve attached a short rate-limit cheat sheet (rate-limit-sheet.pdf) and the quickstart doc. If Jenna wants, I can schedule a 30-minute tech walkthrough to walk through the Postman collection and demo a simulated spike.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@finly.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@finly.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval — quickstart & rate limits

Thanks — that all looks good. Jenna will take the quickstart and try to spin up a test endpoint next week. Please go ahead and provision the isolated eval project and enable 180-day audit log retention.

Also please add the static egress IP ranges for us-west to the HubSpot deal so our security team can start the allowlisting review.

We’re targeting initial pilot results by June 11. If the hosted eval shows predictable latency/cost we’ll discuss a short Dedicated burst for sustained throughput.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
—
Samantha
